glossary
gate — the rising-edge armed-bit: fire only on the meaningful transition, not every frame
watchspec — the compiled goal: sense, hero, channel, consequence, fire_when — the tunable surface
hero — the held subject (re-ID); wrong hero ⇒ downstream noise
consequence — miss_cost × false_fire_cost; drives when to escalate to the VLM
Verdict — the VLM's grounded yes/no: {satisfied, confidence, evidence}
